rows.grounds: compound nirmālya-bhojinī, one who consumes offered remnants
pronoun indicating association with the preceding deity or mantra

items.question: Which goddess is identified as the eater of his remnants?
premises: A goddess is associated with him.
This goddess consumes the offered remnants.
items.inference: Tripuracaṇḍikā is his goddess who eats the remnants.
items.plain_english: And his goddess Tripuracaṇḍikā is the eater of remnants.
